specs.title: hinge: a lid swings up after the finger, falls shut by its weight, stays open past upright
hinge: a part shown open by its controls starts open, and ↺ brings it back open
hinge: a spring brings it home, and the stops hold
slider: stuck until pulled, slides between its stops, friction holds it
slider: without friction it slides back down under its weight
dial: turned around and around, it coasts after a flick and settles on a click
socket: a piece taken out clicks back into its place when brought close
break: holds and bends a little, snaps off when pulled hard, ↺ mends it
break: a piece on a loose piece rides along, and a hard landing knocks it off
parents: a part on a hinged part rides with it (a lamp's arms)
upright: a whole toy rights itself after a tip, keeping its turn
swap: a piece off its place shows its kit-built stand-in and a fill; home, the scan's own

reseating: an earlier loose-body collision cannot unpin the repaired joint
impacts: a moving piece still knocks a previously pinned piece loose
